name: LDAP / Active Directory contacts
author: AiPBX
description: Reads the people of your company directory (Active Directory, OpenLDAP) into the AiPBX phonebook, so desk phones find them by name and show who is calling.

description_i18n.en: Reads the people of your company directory (Active Directory, OpenLDAP) into the AiPBX phonebook, so desk phones find them by name and show who is calling.
description_i18n.tr: Şirket dizininizdeki (Active Directory, OpenLDAP) kişileri AiPBX rehberine alır; masa telefonları onları adıyla bulur ve arayanın adını gösterir.

settings_schema.label: Do not check the server certificate
settings_schema.help: Only for a test directory with a self-signed certificate.

settings_schema.label: User (bind DN or user@domain)
settings_schema.help: A user that can only read. Empty: anonymous.

settings_schema.label: Filter
settings_schema.help: Active Directory, people who are not disabled: (&(objectCategory=person)(objectClass=user)(!(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=2))(|(telephoneNumber=*)(mobile=*)))

settings_schema.label: Attribute: unique id
settings_schema.help: objectGUID (Active Directory) or entryUUID (OpenLDAP). Empty: the entry's DN.
